selection: Fixed before R15G scores; same cases and sampled frames as prior versions
scope: Sampled frames establish visible shape/process issues, not a complete temporal or population quality rating

VP004.observation: More hand/object movement, but malformed horizontal object separates into floating ribbon/shard-like pieces; no clear correct ruler bend and propagating crack. The initial object is already malformed in the shared input image.

VP010.observation: Mop/head moves and generally remains near floor, but head changes shape and a bright water/foam jet or sheet appears late; water does not reliably disappear.

VP027.observation: Visible hand repositioning and pressing, with some dough deformation; mostly remains the initial rounded shape. Clearer activity than nearly static F normal, but sampled frames do not establish a complete shaping process.

VP034.observation: Balloon translates vertically/laterally with little clear sustained expansion. Requested inflation remains weak or unestablished.

VP038.observation: Roller remains more recognizable through sampled frames than F normal/native-guidance where it turned into blobs. Still mixes with fence rail early, and handle/contact geometry changes; complete correct painting/coverage process is not established.
VP038.relative_improvement: Object recognizability and shape retention versus inspected F modes
